title: C4: PID after the order, opening a second PATIENT_RESULT
tests: structure: optional group (PATIENT) absent in the first repetition, its entry segment found later
structure: PID opens PATIENT_RESULT[2], whose required ORDER_OBSERVATION is missing
knownBug: The optional group is looked up in the rest of the message; the validator reports ORC, OBR and OBX as misplaced and ORDER_OBSERVATION as missing (5 errors instead of 1).
